Sets discount approval authority for direct enterprise sales for calendar 2025.

This policy is effective from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.

# Approval Authority Matrix — Enterprise Discounts (2026)

Applies to discount requests governed by the Northstar Pricing Policy 2026.

| Role | Discount authority |
|---|---|
| Enterprise Account Executive | ≤10% |
| VP Sales | >10% and ≤20% |
| Chief Revenue Officer | >20% |

Notes:

The decision record DEC-2026-0001 shows the governance agent's outcome as APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION on 2026-09-23. Michael Torres (VP Sales) then approved it on 2026-09-24.

**Rules in force at the time:**
- **Policy:** Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 and its Approval Authority Matrix (APP-MATRIX-2026) both ran from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Under them, an Enterprise Account Executive can approve up to 10%. Anything over 10% and up to 20% needs VP Sales, and over 20% needs the Chief Revenue Officer.
